summary: Start with a minimal evidence registry, the exact coupled-system certificate and the short qubit lemma. Prepare calibration and full-cycle studies after their explicit gates. Treat the Yang–Mills rate as a separately capped proof attempt. These are estimates of tractability, not promises that a target will be proved.

tasks.title: Make theorem scope enforceable in the research graph
tasks.whyNow: The five exact scope records and adversarial examples already exist; the missing piece is a shared evidence workflow.
tasks.target: Migrate five statement records into a typed registry and bind four selected claim pairs without strengthening any theorem claim.
tasks.premises: Exact revisions, manuscript/declaration identity and separate documentary, semantic-review, executed-proof and physical-evidence fields. Imported logs and test fixtures retain immutable provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Five lossless records; all seven frozen receipt mutations and an independent withheld control handled correctly; no dangling graph IDs or unsupported proof promotion. Each mutation must reach its intended validator stage; a generic fixture-only rejection is insufficient.
tasks.negativeControl: A zero-exit log for the wrong declaration, source or dependency hash must fail association; disallowed or missing axiom evidence cannot pass.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on disputed semantics, unavailable pins, a failed withheld acceptance or the four-hour cap. Preserve the failure.
tasks.novelty: Project verification infrastructure; no new mathematics.
tasks.deliverable: research/claim-registry/: schema, records, graph bindings, validator, fixtures and verification receipt.
tasks.sourceUse: OpenAI 215/276/342/365/372 exact scope records; ICML 2026 statement-fidelity research. No external theorem is newly certified.

tasks.title: Certify the full coupled circuit’s energy balance
tasks.effort: Cap: 14 agent-hours · 5 CPU minutes/run · 1 GiB; optional Lean separately capped
tasks.whyNow: The six-state equations and independent phasor model exist. Exact scalar checks can now be extended to mutual inductance, reciprocal coupling and both source ports.
tasks.target: Check positive storage Q and exact rational identities QA+AᵀQ=−2L D Lᵀ and QB=Cᵀ for the frozen six-state fixture.
tasks.premises: Constant physical coefficients, positive magnetic determinant and storage, nonnegative losses, explicit units and both voltage/force ports. Arbitrary time-dependent drives remain allowed.
tasks.acceptance: Independent exact checker accepts fixture, lossless case and consistent signed coordinate transform; all wrong controls fail. A separately labeled browser adapter passes all 15 parameters with F=0 and RMS units.
tasks.negativeControl: Reverse only one reciprocal sign, omit mutual storage or nonzero force work, change A to mA without conversion, or omit a nondefault adapter parameter.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on domain, semantic or source-binding failure or cap. Time-varying coefficients require rederived dynamics and control-work terms; no silent extension.
tasks.novelty: New project coverage of established passive-network mathematics. Rational instance, general derivation, browser comparison and Lean are distinct evidence.
tasks.deliverable: execution/methods/: contract, matrices, factor witnesses, independent checker, mutation and adapter results, review.
tasks.sourceUse: ICML 2026 exact-certificate and statement-fidelity methods; actual emSolve source. No neural solver or full NSPI reproduction required.

tasks.title: Prove exactly how dephasing reduces accessible work
tasks.effort: Cap: 3 producer hours; review shared with E2
tasks.whyNow: The thermal-channel calculator is independently checked; its all-parameter work-loss bound and endpoint cases remain to be packaged and reviewed.
tasks.target: For a valid qubit with gap ε>0 and dephasing d∈[0,1], prove 0≤W(1)−W(d)≤ε|c|(1−d), including all equality and degenerate cases.
tasks.premises: Fixed energy population and energy-basis dephasing. Ergotropy assumes unrestricted ideal cyclic unitaries; actual hardware control cost is separate.
tasks.acceptance: A complete algebraic proof plus independently selected direct-unitary examples, including p=1/2,d=0 and positivity-forced c=0 endpoints.
tasks.negativeControl: Reject W=E for a passive diagonal state and reject a derivative that divides by a zero Bloch-vector length.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on an unresolved domain/equality case or failed independent example. Numerical samples cannot replace the proof.
tasks.novelty: Established qubit theory applied and certified in this project; global mathematical novelty is not claimed.
tasks.deliverable: An exact lemma, equality ledger, operator checks and review under research/thermal-cycle-v1/.
tasks.sourceUse: OpenAI 276 supplies the related damping channel, not this work theorem; coherent-ergotropy experiment and current damping literature motivate the application.

tasks.title: Close an ideal cycle without hiding the used reservoir
tasks.effort: Cap: 10 producer + 3 shared review hours · 5 CPU minutes · 512 MiB · dimension ≤16
tasks.whyNow: The generalized channel and separately reviewed heat ledger provide a concrete starting state and an energy-conserving interaction.
tasks.target: Construct Gibbs-orbit preparation, excitation exchange, local extraction and a 16-dimensional joint swap; target W_cycle,on=D(ω_X‖τ_X)/β≥0 for the declared ideal device cycle.
tasks.premises: One positive temperature, equal gaps, d=1, endpoint-decoupled Hamiltonians and initially product references. Retain the complete used four-state reservoir, including its correlations.
tasks.acceptance: Derive the operation/free-energy identity under its premises, then pass frozen state-closure, positivity, entropy and energy gates and independent operator/resource review. Bounds, simulated work and measured cost are separate.
tasks.negativeControl: Correlated diagonal and product states can share marginal energies; the full-state reset check must distinguish them. Omitted reset, inverted resources and lower-bound-as-achieved-cost claims must fail.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on missing ports, unresolved proof, failed independent control or cap. Prohibit reservoir reuse or apparatus-efficiency claims without regeneration and real control accounting.
tasks.novelty: A project cycle model applying established thermodynamics; no new energy source or capacity theorem.
tasks.deliverable: research/thermal-cycle-v1/: constructive operators, ≤54 frozen producer cases, resource ledger, countercontrols and review.
tasks.sourceUse: OpenAI 276 channel map plus relative-entropy thermodynamics; full joint-state accounting extends the earlier model. No generic capacity conclusion imported.

tasks.title: Find what calibrated data identify despite unknown gain
tasks.effort: Cap: 8 producer + 2 reviewer hours · 60 CPU minutes · 1 GB · ≤2,000 records
tasks.whyNow: The earlier scaling ambiguity is established. Calibrated mass and several complex responses can now test a specified three-parameter model with nuisance uncertainty.
tasks.target: Assess log(E), log(ρ), log(g) using fixed fit frequencies 30/36/54/63 kHz and held-out 33/59 kHz, with calibrated mass, radius, Poisson reference and a separate pole estimate.
tasks.premises: Fixed finite sphere/receptance model; shared clock, geometry, phase and calibration uncertainty. Gain stresses are only the declared slopes ±0.25 and delays ±1 μs.
tasks.acceptance: Freeze likelihood/statistic/seeds and obtain independent covariance review first. Then require rank/conditioning, interval coverage and held-out discrimination under predeclared thresholds; publish abstentions and failures.
tasks.negativeControl: Common E/ρ/g scaling, duplicated channels, zero excitation and gain functions identical at sampled points must not yield false identification. One frequency cannot certify constant gain.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on structural ambiguity, unresolved covariance or cap. Arbitrary unsampled gain behavior remains unknowable; the dependent position-pole benchmark stays parked.
tasks.novelty: Synthetic calibration and experiment-design work. No actual copper movement or intrinsic location-dependent frequency effect measured.
tasks.deliverable: Calibration map/Jacobian, frozen nine-scenario benchmark, uncertainty budget and acceptance/abstention ledger.
tasks.sourceUse: OpenAI 372 specifies the much stronger full boundary operator; ICASSP 2026 SVD and current inverse-acoustics sources inform finite measurement rank, not general uniqueness.

tasks.title: Replace a finite-range rate with an effective all-size bound
tasks.effort: Cap: 5 producer + 3 reviewer hours · 10 CPU minutes · 512 MiB
tasks.whyNow: Round33 supplies the correlation decomposition and shows why the old half-box schedule eventually loses its useful bound.
tasks.target: In the unchanged patterned SU(2) model, seek an explicit C with correlation error ≤C N^(−1/4)‖A‖² for every N≥5, F1/F2 and |θ|≤8.
tasks.premises: Fixed spacing and |τ|≤10⁻⁸; source-to-equation reconciliation, complete approximant-product support and a new radius-dependent decomposition must be established before arithmetic.
tasks.acceptance: Frozen r=2 for N<16, floor(N^(1/4)) thereafter; certify N=5…255 and prove an analytic tail for N≥256. Construct one common C and obtain independent support/tail review.
tasks.negativeControl: The old half-box schedule must fail unrestricted decay while retaining its valid finite interval. Replacing the full support volume with the original observable support must be rejected.
tasks.stopRule: Stop on missing source premise, unsupported decomposition, failed tail or cap. No automatic radius retuning or fallback.
tasks.novelty: Candidate new effective bound within the project; scientific priority unverified. This does not establish continuum Yang–Mills.
tasks.deliverable: attempts/ym-p1/: source map, lemma, exact/interval checker, independent review and receipt or explicit obstruction.
tasks.sourceUse: Pinned Round33 BB1/BB2/BA2 obligations. OpenAI 215 provides a limit/normalization checklist only; none of its spin-model constants are imported.

stages.title: Roadmap review / identify distinct unfinished tasks
stages.result: Six specialists compared current project gaps with the consolidated sources and proposed bounded candidates.
stages.objection: Repeating a previous simulation is not a new result; complete boundary data, uniform gaps and free resets cannot be assumed.
stages.revision: Prioritize six concrete targets; separate mathematical attempts, engineering work and measurement design. Correct the Yang–Mills prefactor wording.

stages.title: Planning 1 / specify attempts and challenge assumptions
stages.result: The advisor selected tracks, and every specialist wrote a contract with controls, effort caps and stop rules.
stages.objection: A single magnitude hides frequency-dependent gain; an 8×8 limit cannot hold the proposed joint reset; browser defaults describe another circuit.
stages.revision: Require multiple held-out frequencies, an explicit reset construction and every solver parameter. Keep proof receipts distinct from locally observed execution.

stages.title: Planning 2 / resolve objections and freeze remaining gates
stages.result: Final plans use a 16D joint swap with the used reservoir retained, fixed acoustic samples with nuisance covariance, full EM parameter binding and explicit all-N proof gates.
stages.objection: A corrected plan still needs implementation and evidence; arbitrary driving is allowed even though time-varying model coefficients require extra work terms.
stages.revision: Keep pre-execution gates and independent reviews visible. Park the pole classifier, bosonic expansion, reduced models and grand open targets.
